title: Getting angry fries $50 million of computers at the Augsburg field station
place_text: Augsburg, Germany (and East German Soviet computers)

tellings.quote: When I did, the entire field station went down.

plain: In the 1980s, at a US military listening station in Augsburg, Germany, a former Army sergeant named Lyn Buchanan says that a moment of his own anger knocked out about $50 million worth of computers. He tells it as something he did himself: "the entire field station went down." He tells it as a sign that the mind can affect machines directly.
